subject: quartz-manager-standalone
registration_stage: source and environment feasibility inspection; no failure search or mutation execution
purpose: application excluded from development; positive-control transfer feasibility only
release_source_equivalence: GitHub compare confirms only README.md differs between release and inspected commit; backend and frontend application source match.

distribution.mode: Official Maven Central executable standalone jar with embedded native UI
distribution.build_deviation: Use published release; do not rebuild or claim local upstream unit-suite execution.

eligibility.equivalent_actor: native default showcase admin account, role ADMIN; synthetic local instance only
eligibility.reset_method: restart process; default Quartz RAMJobStore loses stored jobs and triggers
eligibility.meaningful_write: create stored durable job, then change description
eligibility.consumer: load same stored job in native edit drawer or API, preserve other fields, submit description update, read persisted job
eligibility.independent_requirements: JobController and frontend JobService expose the same create/update job endpoints; native form maps the stored job fields.
eligibility.scheduler_execution_control: Native managed scheduler defaults to not auto-starting. Create no trigger, never call start/resume/trigger endpoint; verify no triggers and scheduler not running before/after.

planned_workflow.normalization: No generated-key comparison needed: fixed group/name. Ignore execution timestamps only if present; require matching stored business fields and no triggers.

scope_limits: Mapping and environment configuration only; no method or oracle policy tuning from application failure yield.
No malformed-input or known-fault tests are planned in this transfer control.
One workflow cannot establish generalization, prevalence or selector effectiveness.
RAM store configuration only; PostgreSQL persistence not evaluated.
